description.p: NiOn (Minimal Onion) is a minimal Linux web browser for clearnet and .onion sites. Browsing traffic is routed through NiOn's bundled Tor runtime.
NiOn provides multi-tab browsing, persistent sessions, Onion-Location discovery, downloads, and practical fail-closed privacy hardening.
NiOn is not Tor Browser and does not claim Tor Browser-grade anti-fingerprinting or anonymity guarantees.
